gameName: Kenny G: Keepin' It Saxy Game
firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently played a musical instrument starts with the saxophone First Player Marker.
clarifications: The Sax phase begins with the marker holder and proceeds clockwise.
At the end of each round, pass the marker to the next player on the left.
